characters.prompt_summary: A powerful nine-tailed fox demon, a survivor of ancient Chinese mythological wars. She is typically seen in tattered white robes, symbolizing her fallen state, but in memories, she wears elegant, simple traditional attire when younger and at peace. Her true form is that of a nine-tailed fox.
Jiang Ziya, a stern and resolute Taoist general, carries a divine demon-slaying sword. He wears solemn, dark Taoist general attire, reflecting his authority and duty in ancient Chinese mythology.

A mysterious man with a gentle and comforting demeanor, dressed in simple traditional clothing. He is connected to ancient Chinese mythology, and his fate is intertwined with Jiang Ziya and the fox demon.

locations.prompt_summary: An ancient, weathered God-Sealing Platform, shrouded by ominous, swirling dark clouds. Divine lightning occasionally streaks across the sky, accompanied by rumbling thunder. This setting evokes a tragic, solemn, and oppressive atmosphere from Chinese mythology.

A serene and ethereal peach blossom forest in full bloom, bathed in peaceful, comforting light. This idyllic setting contrasts sharply with the somber ancient Chinese mythological backdrop, appearing dreamlike and tranquil.

props.prompt_summary: A massive, majestic longsword adorned with sacred runes. It exudes an aura of immense power and divine authority.
